title: nedCAPTCHA 2 (REDCap External Module)
description: nedCAPTCHA 2 is a REDCap External Module that adds CAPTCHA protection to public surveys without using external CAPTCHA services. It supports math, distorted-image, and custom challenge-response CAPTCHAs configured through REDCap action tags on the first public survey page.
